Class StatBlock

java.lang.Object
src.StatBlock
public class StatBlock extends Object
Data-only class containing the numerical stat block of each pokemon Each member is public as accessors and mutators are redundant in a data-only class - int hp - int attack - int defence - int spAttack - int spDefense - int speed
